articles.summary: – Results Highlight the Potential of Long-Acting Regimens, Including Twice-Yearly and Once-Weekly Options, to Transform the Treatment and Prevention of HIV – Gilead Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: GILD) today announced its upcoming participation in the International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection ( HIV Glasgow 2026 ), taking place from November 8-11. As a leader in HIV innovation, Gilead will share new clinical data and real-world evidence from its HIV research and development programs and provide updates on its strategic initiatives and key collaborations. Results from more than 50 studies, including late-breaking data and two oral presentations, along with Gilead-led symposia and community forums, reflect the company’s person-centered approach to advancing scientific discovery and the importance of partnership to help end the HIV epidemic. articles.summary: – iMMagine-1 Data Provide 18 Months Minimum Follow-Up on Anito-cel’s Durability and Safety in Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma – – Five-Year ZUMA-12 Follow-Up Data to Provide Long-Term Evidence for Yescarta ® in First-Line High-Risk Large B-cell Lymphoma – Gilead Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: GILD) and Kite, a Gilead Company, today announced 23 presentations, including 7 oral presentations, will be presented at the 68th American Society of Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting and Exposition (December 12–15, 2026). These latest clinical milestones demonstrate transformative progress across Gilead and Kite’s pipeline and portfolio, from new data for the investigational anitocabtagene autoleucel (anito-cel) in relapsed or refractory (RR) multiple myeloma (MM), to early clinical results from our next-generation approaches in lymphoma and autoimmune blood disorders, and long-term follow-up data supporting standard-of-care therapies.
